provenance.notes: Reconstructed from whoeasy test fixture whois.gg/clean.gg.txt (MIT, commit a8347b8011, captured 2026-03-16): layout, banner and wording kept; the name, registrar, nameservers and dates are synthetic and contact data is removed. CIDR serves .gg and .je from one back end with the same layout (compare whois.je/bikers.je.txt). Not captured by this project: outbound TCP port 43 was blocked on the development network on 2026-10-05. Registry terms of use and contact details are omitted for publication.
